one_line_pitch: Evidence-gated document execution for high-stakes business workflows
submission_line: Your Agent Shouldn't Sign That — ProofDesk separates reversible PDF work from irreversible signature through a server-side authority gate.
acceptance_gate: Demo a premature signature attempt that fails, resolve the blocker, then show the same path becoming authorized and reaching Foxit eSign with a human signer.

criteria.description: End-to-end flow starts from a plain-language prompt, not a form or config
criteria.pass_condition: Case created with natural language prompt (>= 20 chars), no structured config required
criteria.fail_condition: Case requires JSON config, form fields, or template selection as input
criteria.sponsor_quote: starts from a plain prompt and ends with a signed document
criteria.demo_script_step: 0:00-0:20 — Enter plain prompt: 'Prepare Northstar Data Systems for a $42,500 annual software procurement...'

criteria.description: Foxit PDF Services used through MCP for meaningful reversible work (merge, compare, compress, or convert)
criteria.pass_condition: Audit event with Foxit PDF operation (merge/compress/convert) visible in timeline
criteria.fail_condition: No Foxit PDF operation in audit trail or only signature operation
criteria.sponsor_quote: use Foxit PDF Services through MCP for meaningful reversible work, e.g. merge approval memo + evidence appendix; compare revisions; compress/convert final packet
criteria.demo_script_step: 2:15-2:40 — Show Foxit MCP merge/compress in execution timeline

criteria.description: Signature is NOT exposed as an unrestricted agent tool — it is gated server-side
criteria.pass_condition: SignatureGate function exists in server code, not callable as agent tool
criteria.fail_condition: Signature exposed as unrestricted tool or no server-side gate
criteria.sponsor_quote: Signature is not exposed as an unrestricted tool
criteria.demo_script_step: 1:20 — Show premature signature attempt blocked by server-side gate

criteria.pass_condition: Gate returns allowed=false with UNRESOLVED_BLOCKER reason when blockers exist
criteria.fail_condition: Gate allows signature with unresolved blockers
criteria.demo_script_step: 0:55-1:20 — Attempt signature, gate denies with UNRESOLVED_BLOCKER

criteria.description: SignatureGate checks human approval is present

check_params.precondition: case state=PREPARED but no human approval

criteria.pass_condition: Gate returns allowed=false with NO_HUMAN_APPROVAL when no approval exists
criteria.fail_condition: Gate allows signature without human approval
criteria.demo_script_step: 1:00 — Gate shows NO_HUMAN_APPROVAL in denial reasons

criteria.description: SignatureGate checks structured record hash matches approval hash
criteria.pass_condition: Gate compares record hash at approval time vs current record hash
criteria.fail_condition: No hash comparison or gate skips this check

criteria.description: SignatureGate checks artifact hash is frozen/current (not stale)
criteria.pass_condition: Gate verifies generated artifact hash matches what was approved
criteria.fail_condition: No artifact hash check or stale artifact accepted

check_params.precondition: all other conditions met but no signer

criteria.pass_condition: Gate requires signer field before allowing signature

criteria.description: Foxit eSign called directly after gate passes, with human signer
criteria.pass_condition: Foxit eSign API called with human signer email after gate passes
criteria.fail_condition: eSign called without gate passing or no signer
criteria.sponsor_quote: Only then call Foxit eSign directly. Human performs signature.
criteria.demo_script_step: 2:15-2:40 — Foxit eSign sent to human signer

criteria.description: Signature status becomes an audit event in the receipt
criteria.pass_condition: SIGNATURE_REQUESTED and SIGNED events exist with signer and timestamp
criteria.fail_condition: No signature events in audit trail
criteria.sponsor_quote: Signature status becomes an audit event
criteria.demo_script_step: 2:40-3:00 — Show signature events in receipt timeline

criteria.description: Authority handoff from reversible to irreversible is explicitly defended in demo/narration
criteria.pass_condition: Demo narration explicitly distinguishes reversible PDF work from irreversible signature
criteria.fail_condition: No distinction made between PDF prep and signature
criteria.sponsor_quote: Signing is not a document transformation. It is an authority transition.
criteria.demo_script_step: 2:15-2:40 — Narrate: 'PDF prep is reversible. Signature creates commitment.'
